in_marathi.name: Divyansha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Divyansha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Divyansha is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘divya’ meaning divine and ‘ansha’ meaning appearance, manifestation, or presence. This name reflects the radiant and shining nature of the divine.
